07Bestiary

Bestiary
Bugs slain

A taxonomy of the bugs I handle in QA — from game-breakers to small UI nits.

Critical

Game-breaking bugs

Bugs that make the game unplayable — an undodgeable boss attack, a soft-lock that traps a player mid-run. Top priority in every QA session.

reproduce & block
High

Balance bugs

Damage and difficulty drifting from the design — a boss hitting twice as hard as intended, a bullet pattern too dense to survive. Caught in playtests.

balance pass
Medium

Progression bugs

Progression and meta bugs — an upgrade that never drops, a currency that doesn't save, a run that resets. Tracked in Jira, re-verified on every build.

verify on new build
Low

UI & UX nits

Small interface and UX nits — a tooltip overlapping a button, a label that truncates mid-word. Still fully logged, because players feel every detail.

log & polish
